LanguageData.AG_OriginBladeStudyHelp: Select an undrafted colonist and right-click a blade on the ground to study it. Each study takes one hour and leaves the weapon intact. Study five distinct melee weapon types with cutting or stabbing attacks; material and quality variants count only once. For example: knife, ikwa, spear, gladius, and longsword. Completed studies are permanent. Interrupted studies must be restarted. Once all three requirements are met, Origin: Blade awakens automatically and permanently, even if skills later decline.
LanguageData.AG_OriginBladeWarning: Awakening permanently removes all psycasts and psylink levels and prevents future psycast progression. The pawn can no longer equip ranged weapons (guns, bows, or launchers); any equipped ranged weapon will be unequipped. Rain, Loose, and Grasp remain usable. Psychic sensitivity is unchanged.
